Prob056_ece241_2013_q7.code:
module TopModule (
    input  logic clk,
    input  logic j,
    input  logic k,
    output logic Q
);

    // Sequential logic: positive-edge triggered JK flip-flop
    always_ff @(posedge clk) begin
        case ({j, k})
            2'b00: Q <= Q;       // Hold state (Q unchanged)
            2'b01: Q <= 1'b0;    // Reset
            2'b10: Q <= 1'b1;    // Set
            2'b11: Q <= ~Q;      // Toggle
        endcase
    end

endmodule

module TopModule (
    input  [7:0] code,
    output [3:0] out,
    output       valid
);

    assign valid = (code == 8'h45) || (code == 8'h16) ||
                   (code == 8'h1e) || (code == 8'h26) ||
                   (code == 8'h25) || (code == 8'h2e) ||
                   (code == 8'h36) || (code == 8'h3d) ||
                   (code == 8'h3e) || (code == 8'h46);

    assign out = valid ? (code == 8'h45 ? 4'd0 :
                          code == 8'h16 ? 4'd1 :
                          code == 8'h1e ? 4'd2 :
                          code == 8'h26 ? 4'd3 :
                          code == 8'h25 ? 4'd4 :
                          code == 8'h2e ? 4'd5 :
                          code == 8'h36 ? 4'd6 :
                          code == 8'h3d ? 4'd7 :
                          code == 8'h3e ? 4'd8 :
                          4'd9) : 4'd0;

endmodule

Prob076_always_case.label: d3
Prob076_always_case.code:
module TopModule (
    input  [2:0] sel,       // 3 bits
    input  [3:0] data0,
    input  [3:0] data1,
    input  [3:0] data2,
    input  [3:0] data3,
    input  [3:0] data4,
    input  [3:0] data5,
    output [3:0] out
);

    // 6-to-1 mux: select data based on sel[2:0]
    // If sel is outside 0..5, output 0 (4'b0000)
    assign out = (sel >= 3'd0 && sel <= 3'd5) ? 
                 (sel == 3'd0 ? data0 :
                  sel == 3'd1 ? data1 :
                  sel == 3'd2 ? data2 :
                  sel == 3'd3 ? data3 :
                  sel == 3'd4 ? data4 :
                                  data5) :
                 4'b0;

endmodule
